info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Generate Lite-spec
info.description: The Lite Specification Generation API facilitates the creation of streamlined specs for production environments. Designed for developers and project managers, this API allows users to generate concise specifications tailored to project requirements. By submitting necessary parameters via a POST request, consumers can automate the drafting process, ensuring consistency and saving time. Common use cases include integration with build systems and project documentation tools, helping teams streamline their workflows and improve collaborative efforts.
